cmd:
# Gitea first-run setup via API
# Create admin user
curl -s -X POST 'http://localhost:3000/api/v1/admin/users'   -H 'Content-Type: application/json'   -d '{
    "username": "p3admin",
    "password": "p3agentcell2026",
    "email": "p3admin@localhost",
    "must_change_password": false,
    "admin": true
  }' 2>&1 | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print("User:", d.get("login","?"), "ID:", d.get("id","?"), "Admin:", d.get("is_admin","?"))' 2>&1

echo '---'

# Generate token for the user
curl -s -X POST 'http://localhost:3000/api/v1/users/p3admin/tokens'   -H 'Content-Type: application/json'   -u 'p3admin:p3agentcell2026'   -d '{"name": "p3-bridge", "scopes": ["all"]}' 2>&1

echo '---'

# Create relay repo
curl -s -X POST 'http://localhost:3000/api/v1/user/repos'   -H 'Content-Type: application/json'   -u 'p3admin:p3agentcell2026'   -d '{"name": "p3-relay", "private": true, "description": "P3 Bridge relay - unlimited"}' 2>&1 | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print("Repo:", d.get("full_name","?"), "Private:", d.get("private","?"))' 2>&1
